name: Autonomous Execution Loop Controller
purpose: Control bounded autonomous execution loops using authoritative checkpoints, continuity evidence and explicit work budgets without performing execution itself.

deep_audit.01_purpose: Control autonomous execution loops within explicit safety and resource boundaries.
deep_audit.02_capability_completeness: Loop creation, iteration control, progress tracking, retry control, budget enforcement, checkpoint enforcement and safe stop behavior.
deep_audit.03_inputs: T22 checkpoint, T23 evidence, T24 continuity, T25 budget and loop request.
deep_audit.04_outputs: Deterministic loop state and bounded next-step decision.
deep_audit.05_state_dependency: Canonical project state is read-only evidence and never mutated by T26.
deep_audit.06_evidence_dependency: Execution checkpoint and resolved continuity evidence are prerequisites.
deep_audit.08_downstream_consumers: T27 scheduler, T28 reconciliation, T29 human boundary and T30 handoff.
deep_audit.09_failure_modes: Budget exhaustion, checkpoint mismatch, stale continuity, no progress, retry overflow, replay and invalid loop transitions.
deep_audit.10_security_boundary: Loop control only; no direct execution capability.
deep_audit.11_determinism: Identical loop request and evidence produce identical loop identity and transitions.
deep_audit.12_concurrency: Loop identity collisions are rejected and iteration transitions are serialized.
deep_audit.13_recovery: Paused loops may resume only from a verified checkpoint and valid continuity identity.
deep_audit.14_gpt_limitation_coverage: Prevents infinite autonomous loops caused by context loss, repeated instructions or model uncertainty.
deep_audit.15_new_agent_usability: Loop state is self-contained and machine-readable.
deep_audit.16_cross_chat_continuity: T24 continuity identity is bound into every loop.
deep_audit.17_read_capability: Reads checkpoint, continuity, evidence and budget results.
deep_audit.18_write_capability: Only bounded loop-control evidence is maintained outside canonical controller state.
deep_audit.19_testability: Finite state transitions and numeric limits are independently testable.
deep_audit.20_observability: Iteration, progress, retries, remaining budget and terminal reason are exposed.
deep_audit.21_integration_contract: T25 budget becomes an execution-loop resource envelope.
deep_audit.22_missing_layers: Work scheduling, conflict reconciliation, human decisions and completion remain downstream.
deep_audit.23_authority_permission_boundary: T26 controls loop progression but cannot grant execution authority.
deep_audit.24_idempotency_replay_safety: Loop identity and iteration identity prevent duplicate uncontrolled progression.
deep_audit.25_versioning_migration_compatibility: Loop schema and policy versions are explicit.
deep_audit.26_adversarial_red_team_coverage: Infinite loop, retry storm, budget bypass, checkpoint substitution, stale continuity, replay and no-progress attacks are blocked.
